name: Veil
description: Enter Veil: single-target attacks cannot pick you for up to 2 turns, and it ends when you attack. +10 Momentum.

effects.note: max 2 turns; ends when you attack (the status owns the rule)

mastery.text: Costs 0 on your first action of a fight.
